page0.text:
...
I know what's right.
What keeps me alive.
I can't turn my back on the thing that kept me alive.

page1.text:
"Sorry, Illya. I can't protect something so obvious."
I still my mind and turn it to steel.
It's over.
They all stop—the gastric juices rising to my throat, the pain racking my bowels, and the tears threatening to erupt from my eyes.

page2.text:
I won't compromise my principles.
For the sake of those who couldn't be saved, I won't let any more people share the same fate.

page3.text: "...Oh. In the end, you're choosing the same way as Kiritsugu. You'll abandon the people who are most important to you for someone you don't even know."

page4.text:
...
He was a man who cast aside his most important people for what he believed in.
I've chosen the same path.
This marks the second time I've betrayed Illya.
By choosing not to side with Sakura, I've also chosen not to side with Illya.

page5.text:
"Yeah. I'm the same as Kiritsugu. If you're going to hate someone, hate me."
My heart is turning to hard iron.
Neither scorn nor hatred weigh on me now.

page6.text:
The silver-haired girl doesn't say anything.
Now is her chance to take the revenge she couldn't against Kiritsugu.
And yet...

page7.text:
"I feel sorry for you, Shirou.
You're going to keep deceiving yourself forever, all while looking like you're about to cry."
With a dwindling smile, Illya bids me farewell.

page8.text:
It begins to rain.
There's no one left in the park.
Things should be finished at the church by now.

page9.text:
I open the door.
Tohsaka's standing in a corner of the chapel. It looks like she's been here for a while.
From the way she stands, I can feel a certain determination.
It's the face of a ruthless mage who has decided to treat Sakura as an enemy if the Crest Worms can't be removed.

page10.text:
"..."
Tohsaka doesn't look at me, and I have nothing to say to her.
For a long time, the chapel is filled only with the drumming of the rain.
I'm not sure how long it goes on for.

page11.text:
"The surgery is finished. There is nothing more I can do."
Kirei Kotomine appears, breaking the silence.

page12.text:
"...Kirei. How's Sakura?"
"I've done all that I can. I have nothing more to say."
The outcome is as expected.
There was never any way to save Sakura.

page13.text:
"Sakura Matou is sleeping. She will likely wake up tomorrow morning.
What will you do as the Tohsaka heir, Rin?"
"That goes without saying. It's the administrator's job to drive out a mage that's fallen from the path. Doubly so when it's my own family."

page14.text:
Tohsaka starts walking toward the back of the chapel,
where Sakura is sleeping in a back room.

page15.text:
"You're not going to stop me, Emiya?"
Tohsaka turns to face me as she reaches for the door.
I answer her with silence.

page16.text:
"Then you're fine with this, even if I kill Sakura?"
"I don't have an opinion. But...if we can switch places, then I will."
"No. This is my duty. I can't yield it to you."

page17.text:
Tohsaka opens the door and disappears into the back.
"I'm surprised. I thought you would stop her."
...
"...Hm. So you've made up your mind.
Now the Holy Grail War will return to normal. It is somewhat anti-climactic, but an enjoyable conclusion all its own."

page18.text:
"...Enjoyable? What's so fun about it? Do you like betting on who will win or lose?"
"Predictions? There's no need for such a farce.
...You will win.
Now that you have cast off Sakura Matou, you will use any means necessary to kill Zouken Matou, kill Illyasviel, and kill Rin. That is the outcome I am looking forward to."

page19.text: "...Why? I'm not going to fight Tohsaka. I don't have any reason to stop her from getting the Holy Grail."

page20.text:
"No, you will fight. Once you learn of the Grail's true nature, you will be forced to fight Rin. Now that Rin has been forced to kill Sakura, she will have a breakdown unless she obtains the Holy Grail.
She will try to win for her own convictions, while you will destroy the Grail for your own ideals.
Each of you can no longer abide the other. And so, the final act of this Holy Grail War will fall on your shoulders."

page21.text:
The priest moves to leave the chapel.
He must have guessed that the deed is done,
in the room where Tohsaka is with Sakura.

page22.text:
"So you think I'll be the last man standing."
"Of course. You are now Kiritsugu Emiya. There is no way you would lose."
...The priest departs, leaving only Shirou Emiya in the chapel,
with a mind made of steel.

page23.text:
...
The priest's prediction is true.
I'll keep fighting, defeat Zouken and Illya, drive Tohsaka away, and destroy the Holy Grail.
Then, this war will end.
I've sworn to do the right thing.
This is the first price I must pay to stay true to my ideals.
